explanation: Munch made several versions in paint, pastel and print between 1893 and 1910. He said the image came from a walk at sunset, when he sensed a scream passing through nature.

claims.text: Edvard Munch painted The Scream; the best-known painted version dates from 1893.
Gustav Klimt, Egon Schiele and Wassily Kandinsky did not paint The Scream.
Munch made several versions of The Scream in paint, pastel and lithograph between 1893 and 1910.
Munch wrote that the image came from a walk at sunset during which he sensed a scream passing through nature.
